title: 词典 H
html:
词典 H

概述

本页收录以字母 H 开头的实用词汇，按职场与商务、日常与社交、技术相关等场景分组。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，并附易混淆词辨析和高频短语，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

职场与商务

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
headcount n. 人数、编制 increase/reduce headcount The department's headcount was frozen this quarter.
hierarchy n. 层级结构 organizational hierarchy A flat hierarchy encourages open communication.
highlight v./n. 强调、亮点 highlight key points Let me highlight the main takeaways from the meeting.
hire v./n. 雇用 new hire, hire a candidate We plan to hire three senior engineers this quarter.
horizontal adj. 横向的 horizontal expansion/scaling Horizontal scaling adds more machines to handle traffic.
hurdle n. 障碍 overcome a hurdle Budget approval was the biggest hurdle for the project.
hybrid adj./n. 混合的 hybrid work model Most employees prefer the hybrid work model.
hypothesis n. 假设 test a hypothesis Our hypothesis is that shorter onboarding improves retention.
holistic adj. 整体的 holistic approach/view We need a holistic approach to improve user experience.
halt v./n. 停止 halt operations/production Development was halted pending a security review.
hedge v./n. 对冲、规避 hedge risk Diversifying suppliers helps hedge against supply chain risks.

日常与社交

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
habit n. 习惯 good/bad habit Reading before bed is a habit I picked up last year.
hesitate v. 犹豫 don't hesitate to Don't hesitate to ask if you need any help.
hospitality n. 好客、酒店业 show hospitality The host's hospitality made everyone feel welcome.
household n./adj. 家庭/家用的 household chores/expenses Household expenses have gone up significantly this year.
humble adj. 谦虚的 stay humble Despite his success, he remains very humble.
humor n. 幽默 sense of humor A good sense of humor makes teamwork more enjoyable.
hygiene n. 卫生 personal hygiene Good hygiene habits can prevent many common illnesses.
hectic adj. 忙碌的 hectic schedule/week It's been a hectic week with two major releases.
homesick adj. 想家的 feel homesick She felt homesick during her first month abroad.
hospitable adj. 好客的 hospitable host The local people are incredibly hospitable to visitors.

技术相关

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
handler n. 处理器、处理函数 event handler, error handler The click handler triggers a modal dialog.
hardcode v. 硬编码 hardcode a value Never hardcode API keys in your application.
hash n./v. 哈希 hash function, hash map Passwords are stored as salted hash values.
header n. 头部、请求头 HTTP header, page header Set the authorization token in the request header.
heap n. 堆 heap memory, heap overflow A heap overflow can cause the application to crash.
hook n. 钩子 React hook, Git hook We use a pre-commit hook to run linting automatically.
hosting n. 托管 cloud hosting, web hosting We migrated our hosting from on-premise to AWS.
hotfix n. 紧急修复 deploy a hotfix The team deployed a hotfix to patch the security vulnerability.
HTTP n. 超文本传输协议 HTTP request/response The client sends an HTTP request to the server.
hydration n. 水合/注水 server-side hydration React hydration attaches event listeners to server-rendered HTML.

易混淆词辨析

词组 区别说明
hard vs. hardly hard「努力地/硬的」，hardly「几乎不」。Work hard. / I can hardly believe it.
historic vs. historical historic「历史性的（重大）」，historical「历史的（与历史相关）」。A historic moment. / Historical data.
hear vs. listen hear「听到（被动）」，listen「倾听（主动）」。I heard a noise. / Listen carefully.
hope vs. wish hope「希望（可能实现）」，wish「但愿（难以实现）」。I hope it works. / I wish I had more time.

高频短语

短语 含义 例句
hands-on 亲身实践的 She prefers a hands-on approach to learning new tools.
hold off 推迟 Let's hold off on the release until QA finishes testing.
hand over 移交 He handed over the project to the new team lead.
heads up 提醒 Just a heads up — the server will be down for maintenance tonight.
have a say 有发言权 Everyone on the team should have a say in the tech stack decision.
hit the ground running 迅速上手 The new hire hit the ground running from day one.
hang in there 坚持住 Hang in there — the sprint ends on Friday.
hone in on 聚焦 Let's hone in on the most critical user feedback.

补充词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配
heuristic n./adj. 启发式的 heuristic algorithm
hexadecimal n./adj. 十六进制 hex color code
hibernate v. 休眠 hibernate mode
hitchhike v. 搭便车 hitchhike a ride
hotspot n. 热点 Wi-Fi hotspot
handshake n. 握手 TLS handshake
